datasets.title: Differentially expressed lncRNA in biological premature ovarian insufficiency (bPOI)
datasets._737aff: SOGEN索臻·此为免费流传版·完整增量更新在学科/专题私域群(入群20元防广告)·sogentech.com
datasets.summary: Our study is designed to demonstrate altered profiles of lncRNAs in the granulosa cells from patients with bPOI. Functional studies will be further confirmed. This study will provide new viewpoint for understanding the roles of non-coding RNA for GCs function, as well as potential etiologic mechanism for POI.
datasets.overall_design: We have completed the human LncRNA microarray analysis of the 20 samples.
datasets.study_design: bPOI患者与正常对照的颗粒细胞，lncRNA芯片差异分析

evidence.relevant: 标题和摘要均以bPOI为研究主体，样本轴为bPOI患者与健康对照的颗粒细胞，直接研究POI相关lncRNA差异表达。
evidence.sequencing_type: 实验设计明确为lncRNA芯片；Agilent Feature Extraction处理array图像、GeneSpring归一化，无测序证据，靶向lncRNA，故为lncRNA microarray
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本级无生存时间、状态字段，无法做生存分析
evidence.treatment: 比较轴为bPOI vs 正常对照，无药物干预
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: condition字段：bPOI(10) vs Control(10)，样本描述注明‘age and BMI matched normal control women’，为独立真健康供者；平台为lncRNA microarray（表达定量）；各组≥10人，满足三关。
evidence.correlation: bPOI患者仅10例，不足16例，无法做患者级相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: 所有20个样本的source/cell type均为从卵巢卵泡分离的颗粒细胞(granulosa cells)，属于分离出的具体细胞类型，直接提RNA检测，符合primary_cell定义。

datasets.title: Differentially expressed miRNA in biological premature ovarian insufficiency (bPOI)
datasets.organism: JC polyomavirus; Human immunodeficiency virus 1; Merkel cell polyomavirus; Cytomegalovirus; Betapolyomavirus macacae; Homo sapiens; Rhadinovirus; Betapolyomavirus hominis; Human alphaherpesvirus 1; Human alphaherpesvirus 2; Lymphocryptovirus
datasets.summary: We first examined changes of miRNAs and expression using microarrays ( Exiqon miRCURY™ microarray LNA v.18.0) of GCs from 10 bPOI and 10 age and BMI matched normal control women. Seventy-five miRNAs (Fold Change [FC]>2, P<0.05) were identified differentially expressed between bPOI patients and control women.
datasets.overall_design: Our study is designed to demonstrate altered profiles of miRNAs in the granulosa cells from patients with bPOI. Functional studies will be further confirmed. This study will provide new viewpoint for understanding the roles of non-coding RNA for GCs function, as well as potential etiologic mechanism for POI.
datasets._a3fc4c: SOGEN·索臻·标注这道工序我们替你做了·增量更新加群·公众号光热生物/科研风向标/组学料理

evidence.relevant: 样本为bPOI患者颗粒细胞，研究主体即POI本身的miRNA机制，两轴均直接满足。
evidence.sequencing_type: 芯片为Exiqon miRCURY LNA microRNA array，专门捕获miRNA；读出为GenePix扫描荧光信号，属array；总RNA提取自颗粒细胞群体，bulk分辨率。
evidence.survival_analysis: GSM临床字段仅有cell type、disease state、sex、source，无随访时间（如os_time）和生存状态（如vital_status）字段，无法进行生存分析。
evidence.treatment: 观察性研究，仅比较bPOI患者与正常对照颗粒细胞miRNA差异，无治疗干预。
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: disease state字段明确分为control(10)和bPOI(10)，对照为年龄BMI匹配的正常女性颗粒细胞，独立于疾病组，排除P1–P6陷阱。
evidence.correlation: 平台关通过（miRNA microarray），但目标疾病bPOI患者仅10例，未达>15阈值，不足以支撑表达相关性分析。
evidence.sample_source: 所有20个GSM的source/characteristics均为granulosa cells，是从卵泡液中分离的特定原代细胞类型，离体后直接提取RNA检测miRNA，未进行体外培养，按规则应判定为primary_cell。

datasets.title: Hydroxychloroquine Alleviates Cyclophosphamide-Induced Premature Ovarian Failure by Attenuating Granulosa Cell Senescence and Modulating the mtDNA-cGAS Pathway
datasets.summary: Cyclophosphamide (CTX) is a first-line chemotherapeutic agent for various cancers but is associated with a significant risk of ovarian dysfunction, which may even progress to premature ovarian failure (POF). Granulosa cell senescence is a key phenotypic manifestation of this process. Hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) exerts anti-senescence effects in age-related diseases; however, its efficacy in preventing CTX-induced ovarian damage remains elusive. We aimed to verify the protective effect of HCQ using a CTX-induced POF mouse model.
datasets.overall_design: A controlled animal study was conducted using a CTX-induced POF model in female C57BL/6 mice, encompassing three groups: vehicle control, CTX-only treated, and CTX+ HCQ-treated. HCQ was administered orally at a dosage of 40 mg·kg⁻¹·d⁻¹, beginning 7 days prior to CTX injection (administered at 120 mg·kg⁻¹) and continuing for 4 weeks post-injection.To explore the transcriptomic changes of mouse granulosa cells under cyclophosphamide (CTX) and hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) treatment, we isolated granulosa cells from C57BL/6 mice, and performed RNA sequencing.

datasets.title: Epigenomic landscape of human cumulus cells in premature ovarian insufficiency using single-base resolution methylome and hydroxymethylome. [RNA-Seq]
datasets.summary: Premature ovarian insufficiency (POI) has recently been reported to be linked with epigenetic changes. Previous studies have focused on the regulation of individual genes associated with ovarian function through single-gene epigenetic variations, however, there is a deficiency in the comprehensive comprehension of the epigenetic profile for POI. Therefore, we conducted a multi-omics study integrating methylation, hydroxymethylation, and transcriptome sequencing analyses in cumulus cells from women with POI and their matched controls. Our results showed significantly higher global methylation and hydroxymethylation levels in POI women compared to controls. The number of hyper-methylated/hyper-hydroxymethylated regions exceeded hypo-methylated/hypo-hydroxymethylated regions in differentially methylated and hydroxymethylated regions across chromosomes and genetic elements. Methylation within genebodies remained high and exhibited a slight negative correlation with gene expression. Variation in methylation levels was notable among promoter regions, with gene expression decreasing as methylation levels increased (displaying a pronounced negative correlation). Hydroxymethylation levels in both the genebody and promoter regions remained consistently low and showed no overall association with gene expression. Furthermore, we found that changes in methylation were linked to the epigenetic age clock rather than being specifically associated with POI causative genes or ovarian function genes. Our study sheds light on critical features of POI, characterized by widespread DNA hyper-methylation and hyper-hydroxymethylation across the genome. The observed relationship between hyper/hypo-methylation and gene expression regulation may provide valuable insights for identifying potential epigenetic biomarkers and treatment targets for POI.
